title: Appliance Bundles & SLA Windows: Pricing Experiment for On‑Prem Feature Bundles
creator: Asha Menon
description: Run a structured pricing and packaging experiment for on-prem appliance-style offerings and VPC packages that bundles license fee, support tiers, and controlled upgrade cadences. Problem: enterprise customers ask for predictable TCO for air-gapped and regulated deployments, clear upgrade/patch SLAs, and a simpler procurement SKU. Hypothesis: Introducing a small set of appliance SKUs (hardware-agnostic license bands) with optional paid accelerated-patch and extended-retention tiers will increase deal velocity for Private/VPC by 20% and lift ARR per deal by 15% while preserving margin. Scope: define 3 appliance bands (Base, Business, Critical) with per-band standard upgrade windows (Base: 24-week major cadence, Business: 16-week, Critical: 8-week) and optional add-ons: Accelerated Patch (48-hour security hotfix SLA), Extended Retention (90/365 days audit logs), and Onsite Emergency Support. This ticket covers pricing experiments, contract language proposals for security questionnaires, and pilot with 6 target accounts. Out of scope: changes to hosted API pricing, dedicated reserved capacity billing mechanics.
acceptance_criteria: Pricing bands and add-on price points documented and validated with finance
Contract clauses drafted for upgrade cadence and emergency patch SLA and reviewed by legal
Pilot enrollment checklist for 6 target accounts completed and signed
A/B experiment framework defined with success metrics and dashboard in Looker
Security questionnaire responses updated for appliance SKUs and signed off by Security
experiments: Arm A - Flat annual license per appliance band + standard support included (no accelerated patches)
Arm B - Lower base license plus optional consumption credits and explicit Accelerated Patch add-on priced at 12% of band
Arm C - Hybrid: base license with included one accelerated patch per year, subsequent patches billed per-incident (to test tolerance for bundled emergency coverage)
